sections.title: *-adik/-edik/-odik/-ödik*: "-th"
sections.content: To turn a number into "first, second, third..." Hungarian adds an ending built on *-dik*, chosen by vowel harmony. The first two are irregular and just need to be learned; from three onward the ending is predictable, though the number itself changes a little.

*első* and *második* are irregular — memorize them. From *harmadik* on the ending is *-adik/-edik/-odik/-ödik* by vowel harmony, but the number also changes a little: *három → harmadik*, *négy → negyedik*, *hét → hetedik*, *tíz → tizedik*. Learn each one as a word.
